senses.gloss: लोप disappearance of a word or part of a word enjoined in grammar for arriving at the required forms of a word; cf. अदर्शनं लोपः P. I.1.52: cf. अदर्शनमश्रवणमनुच्चारणमनुपलब्धिरभावो वर्णवि- नाश इत्यनर्थान्तरम् । एतैः शब्दैर्योर्थोभिधीयते तस्य लोप इतीयं संज्ञा भवति Kāś. on P.I.1. 52. This disappearance in the case of an affix is tantamount to its notional presence or imaginary presence, as operations caused by it do take place although the word element has disappeared; cf. प्रत्ययलोपे प्रत्ययलक्षणम् । प्रत्यये लुप्तेपि तद्धेतुकं कार्ये भवति Kāś. on P. I.1.62.

लोपबलीयस्त्व the superior strength or superiority of elision as a gramma- tical operation in contrast with other operations, by virtue of which the elision, which is prescrib- ed, takes place first and then other operations get a scope for their application; cf. सर्वविधिभ्यो लोपविधिर्बलीयान् Par.Śek. Pari. 93.
